_about: Tier-1 knowledge-hierarchy priority set. For each question the TOP-ranked retrieved source must be one of the expected canonical (Tier 1) documents: Prospectus 2026 (admissions/eligibility/fees/programmes), College Handbook (academic rules), Boys/Girls Hostel Prospectus (hostel). expected_top_any matches a substring of the top retrieved chunk's filename. Deterministic — no LLM cost.
